mechanism_narrative: A quarterly increase in GDPC1, indicating strengthening economic demand, boosts consumer and business confidence, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 50% of quarters with positive GDPC1 growth, or Rank IC < 0.02 over any 5-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When FEDFUNDS exceeds 4.5%, signaling a tightening monetary cycle, investors anticipate reduced borrowing capacity, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of instances with FEDFUNDS above 4.5%, or walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.01 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Jointly, when UNRATE falls below 3% and PAYEMS growth accelerates (> 200k new jobs per month), a tightening labor market fuels wage inflation, pressuring equity valuations and leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5d returns in > 55% of triggered instances, or walk-forward Rank IC < 0.05 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 2-month increase in INDPRO, signaling strengthening industrial production, boosts equity markets' expectations of future earnings growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.04 over any 3-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher in periods with sustained INDPRO growth (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When RSAFS exceeds $550B, indicating strong retail sales, consumer confidence is high, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days, but only during the holiday season (Nov-Jan).
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in > 50% of triggered holiday season instances, or walk-forward Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in CPIAUCSL over 2 consecutive months, signaling reduced inflation pressures, leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as investors anticipate more accommodative monetary policy.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 55% of instances with 2-month CPIAUCSL declines, or walk-forward Rank IC < 0.02 over any 5-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Jointly, when UNRATE rises above 4.5% and PAYEMS growth slows (< 100k new jobs per month), a weakening labor market reduces wage pressures, supporting positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances, or walk-forward Rank IC < 0.01 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in HOUST, indicating a strong housing market, boosts expectations of broad economic growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days, but only during the spring-summer season (Mar-Aug).
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in > 50% of spring-summer instances with HOUST growth, or walk-forward Rank IC < 0.04 over any 2-year rolling window.
